description: List media files and assets in the CRM file library with sorting, pagination, and type filtering.

access_token.description: CRM access token (optional — your connected CRM is used when omitted)

altId.description: Alternate ID (location ID or agency ID)

limit.description: Maximum number of files to return

location_id.description: CRM sub-account location ID (optional — defaults to your connected location)

offset.description: Number of records to skip for pagination

query.description: Free-text search query for file names

name: crm_list_media_files
